title: Spectral Monotonicity under Leaf Attachment and Limiting Behavior in Discrete Einstein Trees
summary: Let $R_T$ be the Ricci matrix of a finite tree $T$ introduced in \cite{BaiChengHua2026}, the largest eigenvalue $λ_{\max}(R_T)$ determines the sign of a discrete Einstein metric curvature on the tree. This paper investigates the asymptotic behavior of the sequence $λ_k = λ_{\max}(R_{T_k})$ obtained by repeatedly adding pendant edges at a fixed vertex.
